subject: M10 Port Complementary Reimagined lighting and post pipeline
description:
Complementary Reimagined r5.9.3 downloaded from the official Modrinth CDN (slug complementary-reimagined; game_versions includes 26.2) and unpacked to D:/tmp/shaderport/pack (outside the project, because C: is at 100%). 426 files: 189 .glsl, 108 .vsh, 108 .fsh, 3 .csh. There is NO settings.glsl — every default is a #define at the top of shaders/lib/common.glsl (lines 14-300) with derived defines at 361-660; code lives in lib/** (functions) and program/** (one .glsl per stage). Pass order: shadow, gbuffers, deferred1, composite1-7, final.

Practical note: their GLSL cannot be pasted into a WebGL2 forward renderer anyway (it depends on Iris builtins: shadowtex0/shadowtex1, colortex targets, gbuffers_* stubs, their #include layout). What transfers is the algorithms and the default constants, which is the whole point.

Default values to adopt: SHADOW_QUALITY 2, shadowDistance 192, SHADOW_SMOOTHING 4, SSAO_QUALI 2 / SSAO_I 100, VANILLAAO_I 100, FXAA_DEFINE 1 / FXAA_STRENGTH 75, DETAIL_QUALITY 2 (which force-enables TAA), CLOUD_QUALITY 2 at altitude 192, LIGHTSHAFT 2, WATER_REFLECT 2, BLOCK_REFLECT 3, COLORED_LIGHTING 0, WORLD_SPACE_REFLECTIONS off, BLOOM on at strength 0.12, IMAGE_SHARPENING 5, VIGNETTE on, TM_EXPOSURE 1.00, TM_CONTRAST 1.05, T_SATURATION 1.00, T_VIBRANCE 1.00, TM_DARK_DESATURATION 0.25, TM_WHITE_PATH 1.00, XLIGHT_I 1.00, XLIGHT_CURVE 1.00, blocklightCol (0.1775,0.104,0.077), CAVE_LIGHTING 100, AMBIENT_MULT 100. Motion blur, chromatic aberration, DOF, lens flare and puddles are off.

Implementation order by visual impact: (a) item 7 blocklight two-term curve pow((lmX^4)^(2.8-0.6vb+curve) + lmX*(2.8+0.6vb-curve), 2.25) times blocklightCol, replacing our too-linear l/(4-3l) torch response; (b) item 6 sun colour over the day from lib/colors/lightAndAmbientColors.glsl — noon (1.33,1.13,0.77), sunset pow(0.64,0.45,0.3)^(1.5+invNoon)*5, night 0.9*(0.15,0.14,0.20)*(0.4+0.4vsBright), ambient pow(skyColor,0.75)*0.85 noon / (0.081,0.108,0.153)*(1.55+0.77vsBright) night, plus the non-linear timeAngle clock and noonFactor = sqrt(max(sin(2*pi*timeAngle),0)); (c) item 4 sun fade over the last 16 blocks to skyLightShadowMult = lmY^8; (d) item 14 water — default WATER_STYLE 1 means NO normal map at all: waves are two sines in the vertex stage, worldPos.xz*14 with sin(t*0.7 - z*0.14 + x*0.07) + sin(t*0.5 - z*0.10 + x*0.05), t = frameTime*6*wavingSpeed, wave = sum*0.125 - 0.05, alpha from depth 1-exp(delta*0.075) then color.a = 0.25+0.75*waterFog and alpha = mix(a,1,fresnel^4), foam where NdotU>0.99 in shallow water (this replaces our texture-derivative normals, which are wrong by design); (e) item 12 luminance-aware vignette 1-dot(q,q)*(1-luminance), blue-noise dither +(d-0.25)/128, and a 4-tap unsharp; (f) item 5 wrapped Lambert NdotLM = max0(NdotL+0.4)*0.714 with shadowTime = ((|vis-0.5|*2)^2)^2 and GGX specular (roughness ((1.35-sqrt(0.9s+0.1))^2)^2, f0 0.05, Schlick 2^(-5.55473*LdH-6.98316)*LdH*(1-f0)+f0, energy compromise spec/(0.125*spec+1)); (g) item 8 final mix (directionShade*vanillaAO)^2 * (blockLighting + sceneLighting^2 + minLighting) + emission^2 then sqrt, with directionShade = (0.75+0.25*NdotU)*(1-0.1*|NdotE|^2)*(1+0.075*|NdotN|) plus bounced light 0.05*|NdotN|*lmY^4, vanilla AO (glColor.a+0.08) double-powered by sun angle with a 0.9+0.1 floor, and the cave floor term vec3(0.005625+0.043vsBright)*(0.45,0.475,0.6)*(1-lmY); (h) item 11 replace our invented grade with Modified Lottes 2016 (a=1.05, d=1, hdrMax=8, midIn=midOut=0.25, out = pow(x,a)/(pow(x,a*d)*b+c) then sRGB encode) plus dark-lift, white path toward (1,1,1) with input curve pow(lum/16,1) and dark desaturation 0.25 — and note there is NO auto-exposure in the pack, so our uExposure model goes away; (i) item 10 bloom as a 7-tile mipmap atlas at lods 2-8 with 7x7 binomial kernels (1,6,15,20,15,6,1)^2/4096, pre-curve pow(x/128,0.25), squared four times then *128, summed *0.14 and MIXED at 0.12 rather than added (our current 0.34 additive bloom is the main cause of the milky look); (j) items 1-3 shadow geometry with fractal distortion d = 1-25.6/192, two depth buffers, 2/4/8/16 tap spiral with interleaved-gradient noise, geometric bias 0.12+0.0008*|p|^1.5^(0.75) scaled by (2-0.95*NdotL) and voxel centring, replacing our polygonOffset(1.2,2.5); (k) item 9 SSAO at full res from the existing depth texture, 8 mirrored taps, ao^(SSAO_I*0.004) = ao^0.4, skipped where z<0.56; (l) item 13 TAA (8-step Halton jitter *0.125, RGBA16F history, Catmull-Rom resample, 8-neighbour ClipAABB with depth-edge detection, blend clamp(exp(-7|v|^2)*0.2+0.7-min(|dCam|,0.05)*edge, 0.35)) then FXAA 3.11 at strength 75 — this is what actually kills their shadow shimmer, so it is the real answer to the flicker complaint; (m) item 16 god rays with 10 near samples, pow(t,2) distribution and shadowmap-sampled density, replacing our cone hack. Defer item 15 (volumetric ray-marched clouds, needs a generated noise texture).

WebGL2 mapping: shadow2D becomes COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE plus LINEAR on a DEPTH_COMPONENT24 texture; compute/imageStore/SSBO paths are unnecessary because COLORED_LIGHTING is 0 by default; RGBA16F needs EXT_color_buffer_float and generateMipmap on float targets is unreliable so build the bloom chain with explicit half-res FBO passes; dFdx works in ES3.
